notes.title: Polishing 1
notes.content:
changed menus and some buttons to be less bland

added VFX for some status effects
added status bar so you can see opponents adding
reworked bleed so it fades slower right after applying
removed doll class (will come out after reworking)

fixed a bug that causes .io mode to not work
added message for boss and infect modes when player is lower than the threshold
